0022600029.text: The Grizzlies host the Oklahoma City Thunder in the Emirates NBA Cup West Group B in Memphis, Memphis's 9th game of the season, with both teams at 6-2. Memphis is 3rd in the Southwest, half a game back, and has lost its last two games, while Oklahoma City is 2nd in the Northwest, also half a game back, and has won its last two. Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness) and Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (out, shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (out, knee), Jalen Williams (out, leg fracture), Nikola Topic (out, back), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee), with Jaylin Williams day-to-day and a game-time decision due to back spasms. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Grizzlies lost all three meetings, most recently a 117-116 defeat in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
